(1) we have developed a verified hardware compiler for a language with synchronous and asynchronous constructs; (2) we have developed an algebraic model that can be used to reason about synchronous and asynchronous behaviour; and (3) we have shown that the retargeting of our compiler proof is feasible.
a compiler proof for asynchronous circuits can be retargeted for synchronous circuits and that the retargeting proof can be done with a modest amount of effort.
a compiler can be retargeted from asynchronous to synchronous circuits by proving that a synchronous implementation of the compiler can be used in place of its asynchronous counterpart.
